name: Letter
source:
One Monday morning there was an anonymous love letter in the shoe box. Letters start to be sent every day. Is this a prank or a true feeling?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个星期一的早晨，鞋盒里有一封匿名情书。每天开始寄信。这是恶作剧还是真情实感？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
